name: domain.hermes_cognitive_engine
description: Hermes closed learning loop, autonomous skill formation, verification evidence evaluator, and think stream scrubber

entrypoints.name: create_skill_from_trajectory
entrypoints.description: Extract reusable multi-step tool call trajectory into an OpenSkills formatted skill

parameters.name: tool_sequence
parameters.description: List of tool execution step names in chronological order

entrypoints.name: evaluate_verification_evidence
entrypoints.description: Evaluate pre-commit verification evidence (tests run, lint output, file mutations) before allowing completion

parameters.name: executed_commands
parameters.description: List of shell commands executed during turn

parameters.name: file_mutations
parameters.description: List of files written or edited during turn

entrypoints.name: scrub_think_stream
entrypoints.description: Parse streaming tokens to separate thinking blocks from user-visible response text and stream telemetry

parameters.name: raw_chunk
parameters.description: Raw model output stream chunk with potential think tags

parameters.name: capture_telemetry
parameters.description: Whether to buffer thought text into telemetry channel

entrypoints.name: nudge_learning_persistence
entrypoints.description: Calculate cognitive nudge urgency for persisting extracted learnings based on turn count and complexity
